---
title: "get_HDT_highest_evidence_level"
format: html
---

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(readr)
library(tibble)
library(here)

df <- read_tsv(here("evaluation/labels/launched_drug_with_literature.tsv"))

# article-level records: is_hdt/is_review/evidence_level aren't in the TSV text, only in the JSON 
records <- jsonlite::fromJSON(
  here("evaluation/labels/launched_drug_with_literature.json"),
  simplifyVector = TRUE
) %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  select(pmid, evidence_level, is_hdt, is_review, drugs)

LEVEL_ORDER <- c("clinical_study", "human_subject", "animal", "in_vitro", "other")

# get strongest evidence level among its own HDT-tagged
highest_HDT <- records %>%
  filter(is_hdt, !is_review, lengths(drugs) > 0) %>%
  select(pmid, evidence_level, drugs) %>%
  unnest(drugs) %>%
  mutate(drug = tolower(drugs), level_rank = match(evidence_level, LEVEL_ORDER)) %>%
  group_by(drug) %>%
  slice_min(level_rank, with_ties = TRUE) %>%
  summarise(
    highest_HDT_evidence = first(evidence_level),
    highest_HDT_PMID = {
      p <- sort(unique(pmid[pmid != ""]))
      if (length(p) > 0) paste(p, collapse = "; ") else NA_character_
    },
    .groups = "drop"
  )

df <- df %>%
  mutate(drug = tolower(drug_name)) %>%
  left_join(highest_HDT, by = "drug") %>%
  select(-drug)

df %>%
  select(
    highest_HDT_evidence,
    highest_HDT_PMID,
    everything()
    )

# drugs HDT-positive (n_hdt > 0)
cat("HDT-positive drugs:", sum(df$n_hdt > 0), "\n")
cat("  with primary HDT evidence:", sum(!is.na(df$highest_HDT_evidence)), "\n")
cat("  review-only (no primary HDT record):",
    sum(df$n_hdt > 0 & is.na(df$highest_HDT_evidence)), "\n")

# Summary
df %>%
  dplyr::count(highest_HDT_evidence, sort = TRUE)
```

```{r}
drug_candidates <- c(
  "rosuvastatin",
  "fostamatinib",
  "fluvastatin",
  "tofacitinib",
  "lovastatin",
  "ethinyl-estradiol",
  "atorvastatin",
  "clonidine",
  "nabumetone",
  "tamoxifen",
  "ketotifen",
  "vemurafenib",
  "raloxifene",
  "naltrexone",
  "dasatinib",
  "chlorprothixene",
  "lapatinib",
  "forskolin",
  "sertraline",
  "mometasone"
)

# subset and preserve the order in drug_candidates
df_subset <- df %>%
  filter(tolower(drug_name) %in% tolower(drug_candidates)) %>%
  arrange(match(tolower(drug_name), tolower(drug_candidates)))

write_csv(df_subset,file=here("evaluation/labels/top20HDT_literature.csv"))
```
